q1_issues.issue: Inside the seal, (Time sk_results_1 sk_quarter_1) puts a Time oblique on an entity — "results" is not an event or event-denoting noun, and the instruction set attaches Time atoms to event witnesses only.

"first-quarter" is encoded as a minted quarter witness plus (Ordinal sk_quarter_1 1 quarter); the instruction set gives a fiscal period the bare constant first_quarter (or (Quarter <n> <year>) when the year is stated), so both the witness and the Ordinal are off-form and the Time fillers are witnesses rather than period terms.

The participial adjunct "based on" loses its head: only (On sk_expect_1 sk_results_1) survives, which asserts the expecting is "on" the results and drops "based" without any reified event or recorded gap.

(Member sk_quarter_1 quarter) is emitted twice — projected at top level and repeated as a conjunct inside the sealed (And ...) — whereas the instruction set's seal examples keep only the predication inside and the typing outside.

q2_gaps: a free participial adjunct modifying a clause ("based on first-quarter results, it expects ...") — the reduced-relative rule covers participles post-modifying a NOUN, not a clause-level adjunct
a fiscal-period restriction on a non-event nominal ("first-quarter results", "for the quarter") has no licensed carrier: Time is event-only and the period constant has no slot on an entity
notes: The say/seal routing, the Experiencer holder, the control-infinitive "expects to earn" (top-level-within-seal, controller copied in, no tense of its own) and the cent_per_share rate unit all follow the instruction set.
